name: ops
about: Every operation: {name, permission, params: [{name, required}], about}

name: tools
about: Every agent tool: {name, description, parameters, owner}

name: commands
about: Every slash command: {name, description, owner}

name: status
about: {provider, model, workspace, busy} (busy: of `thread`, if given)

name: messengers
about: Every messenger with its capabilities, notes, actions and threads (each with its place: dm|group|channel|thread, parent, title)

name: send
about: Send {thread, message}; returns its id

name: edit
about: Replace a sent message {thread, id, message}

name: delete
about: Delete a sent message {thread, id}

name: react
about: React to a message {thread, id, emoji}

name: open_thread
about: Open a thread titled {title} inside {thread} (where the messenger can `open_thread`); returns the new thread

name: action
about: Run one of the messenger's described {action}s in {thread} with {args} (checked against its schema); returns its result

name: download
about: Save attachment {file} of a message in {thread} (one of `message_in`'s `files`) to {path} (relative: in the workspace); returns {path, size}

name: inbound
about: Hand in what came to {thread} of a messenger you offer from {user: {id, name}} at {place: {kind: dm|group|channel|thread, parent, title}}: {kind: message|edited|command|press|reaction, ...}

name: listen
about: Listen in {thread} for {buttons, text}; returns a listener id. With {secret} a text taken is deleted from the chat

name: next
about: What {listener} took

name: prompt
about: Hand {thread} a message as if the user sent it

name: turn_start
about: Start a turn {thread, turn: {text, conversation: thread|copy|new, show, source, parent, ...}}; returns its id

name: turn_wait
about: A turn's outcome {id, timeout_ms}

name: turn_cancel
about: Cancel turn {id}

name: turns
about: Running turns, of {thread} or all

name: stop
about: Stop everything running in {thread}, like /stop

name: callTool
about: Run an agent tool {thread, name, input}

name: llm
about: One completion without tools: {prompt} or {messages}, {system}, {effort}, {options} (fields of the provider's request body); in {thread}'s conversation's model, counted in its usage

name: model_set
about: Switch to {model} of the current provider, or `provider:model` (`provider:` for its default)

name: providers
about: Every model provider: {id, label, default_model, extension}

name: models
about: The models {provider} offers (default: the active one): [{id, context_window, max_output, images, tools}], null where unknown

name: accounts
about: Every account extensions sign in to: {id, label, extension, providers, status: none|connected|expired, who}

name: login
about: Sign in to {account}, asking in {thread}; returns {who}

name: logout
about: Sign out of {account}

name: account_update
about: Tell how your {account} stands: {status: none|connected|expired, who}

name: secret_get
about: Your secret {key} (an account's API key is under the account's id)

name: secret_set
about: Keep your secret {key, value} (null deletes)

name: login_ask
about: In your sign-in {session}: ask for {label} ({secret}: deleted from the chat); returns the answer

name: login_choose
about: In your sign-in {session}: {question} with {options} as buttons; returns the one picked

name: login_open
about: In your sign-in {session}: show {url} to open, with {note}

name: login_progress
about: In your sign-in {session}: say {text}

name: login_callback
about: In your sign-in {session}: receive one redirect on localhost {port} (0: any) {path}; returns its address

name: login_wait
about: In your sign-in {session}: the redirect's query {timeout_ms} (or the address the user pastes)

name: sessions
about: Stored conversations, newest first, of {thread} or all: {id, chat, name, settings, messages, bound}

name: session_new
about: Start a new conversation in {thread} (none: of no chat, addressed as thread {messenger: "session", id}), optionally with {name, settings}; returns its id

name: session_update
about: Rename {session} ({name}) or change its {settings}: {model, system, tools, sections}, null deletes

name: session_switch
about: Continue stored {session} in {thread}

name: history
about: The journal of {session} (or {thread}'s, or all): entries after {since} of {kinds}, at most {limit} (default 100)

name: journal_append
about: Record {type, data} in the journal of {session} or {thread}'s (kind `custom`, caller you)

name: messages
about: The live conversation of {thread} (what the model sees next): {session, messages, tokens, window}

name: messages_set
about: Replace the live conversation of {thread} with {messages} (earlier ones stay searchable)

name: search
about: Full-text search over everything said in any conversation: {query, limit} → [{at, role, text}]

name: extensions
about: Every extension with its state and what it registers

name: extension_enable
about: (Re)start {name} and keep it enabled; returns its status line, fails with its error

name: extension_disable
about: Stop {name} and keep it disabled

name: extensions_reload
about: Restart every extension but the caller

name: extension_logs
about: The last {lines} (default 100) lines of extension {name}'s log: its stderr and the core's notes, also while it is down

name: extension_health
about: Ask extension {name} how it is doing now: {status: ok|degraded|failed|hung, detail}

name: settings
about: The calling extension's settings, schema defaults filled in

name: settings_set
about: Set {path, value} in the calling extension's settings (null deletes)

name: config_list
about: Every known setting under {prefix} (default all): [{path, description, type, default, value, secret}]; secrets masked

name: config_get
about: A setting of any unit at {path} (`august.model`, `extensions.web.settings`); secrets masked

name: config_set
about: Change the setting at {path} to {value} (null deletes); `enabled` and `origin` are the user's

name: emit
about: Run your declared event {event, data} through its handlers; returns the data they leave (an observed event: at once)

name: store_get
about: The caller's stored value at {key}

name: store_set
about: Store {key, value} (null deletes)

name: store_list
about: The caller's stored entries under {prefix}
